QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Scorching Sun
QuestInfo.0: Find Eremos to get the location for the next phase of your training.
QuestInfo.1: The Burnt Land is wilderness scorched by the sun, forever altered from what was once a vast frozen tundra. Compared with Riena Strait, it's a harsh training location that could be quite troublesome to explore. Prove your strength and ability to persevere in such a place by hunting 500 of each type of monster in the Burnt Land.
QuestInfo.2: Testing your limits and succeeding in your goals gave you more confidence in your skills!

default.0: It looks as though you have not yet completed your training. Please return once you have achieved your objective.
